items.t: Said his priorities are protecting Colorado businesses and Colorado consumers, and that doing nothing is not an option for him.
items.q: “My priorities are protecting Colorado businesses and Colorado consumers, and if we can’t get past that, I don’t know where we go,” Rodriguez said. “Some people want to do nothing, and that is not an option for me.”

record.t: Sponsored HB26-1326, Sunset Public Utilities Commission, which Governor Polis signed into law.
record.q: Governor Polis signed HB26-1326 - Sunset Public Utilities Commission, sponsored by Majority Leader Monica Duran and Representative Jenny Wilford, and Majority Leader Robert Rodriguez and Senator Lisa Cutter.

record.t: Served as Majority Leader of the Colorado Senate.
record.q: Image Robert Rodriguez, Majority Leader Senator Rodriguez's Legislator Page

record.t: Sponsored Senate Bill 4, which passed the Senate Business, Labor and Technology Committee on a 4-3 vote.
record.q: Senate Bill 4 , a proposal from Democratic Senate Majority Leader Robert Rodriguez of Denver that is backed by consumer-rights and worker-advocacy organizations, passed on a party-line 4-3 vote out of the Senate Business, Labor and Technology Committee.

record.t: Changed the disclosure requirement in Senate Bill 4 so it applies only to individuals for whom AI helped make consequential decisions in areas like health care, housing, lending or insurance.
record.q: Rodriguez changed the 20-characteristics disclosure requirement so that it only would apply to individuals for whom AI had helped to make consequential decisions in areas like health care, housing, lending or insurance.
